location.provenance: SECTION 4. A person may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute in or into this state a foodware container containing perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances.

reference.provenance: SECTION 9. (1) Sections 1 to 4 of this 2023 Act and the amendments to ORS 459.995 by section 8 of this 2023 Act become operative on January 1, 2025.

pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance' means a substance included in a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.
